title: QC - Councils, Committees & Partnerships - 005 - Partners & Offers
description:
1. Frontend — Partners & Offers
Listing, Filter & Browsing (US-001)
User Story
As a public website visitor,
I want to browse the partner
offers available through Qatar Chamber and filter them by category,
So that I can find a benefit
relevant to my business and check its validity before using it.
Preconditions
- The Qatar Chamber website is published and accessible.
- The Partners & Offers page is published.
- At least one partner offer is published and within its
validity window.
- Partner categories are configured and active in the
CMS.
What the Visitor Sees
- Breadcrumb: Home › Committees & Partnerships ›
Partners & Offers.
- Hero: eyebrow "Council, Committees &
Partnerships", the title "Partners & Offers", the page
description, and the hero illustration.
- An offers section: eyebrow "Partner
benefits", heading "Offers for the business community", and the
description "Choose a category to find relevant offers, then review the
complete terms before using a benefit."
- Controls to the right of the section heading: an
"All Categories" dropdown, a reset action, and a "Find"
button.
- A grid of offer cards, three per row. Each card shows
the partner logo, the category label, the partner name and the partner location
with a marker icon;
- an "Offer description" panel containing the
offer text; a validity line with a calendar icon, the label "Valid"
and the offer's start and end dates; a membership tier badge (e.g. "General",
"Elite", "Quest"); and an "Offer details" action
with a "Contract" action.
- A "Load More" action beneath the grid.
Frontend Workflow
- Visitor navigates to Main Menu → Councils, Committees
& Partnerships → Partners & Offers.
- System displays the hero and the "Partner
benefits" section with the dropdown set to "All Categories".
- System displays all published offers that fall within
their validity window.
- Visitor selects a category from the "All
Categories" dropdown and clicks "Find".
- System refreshes the grid to show only offers assigned
to the selected category.
- Visitor clicks the reset action; the dropdown returns
to "All Categories" and the full list is restored.
- Visitor clicks "Load More" to reveal the next
set of offers.
- Visitor clicks "Offer details" on a card; the
system opens the Offer Details modal (see US-002).
- Visitor clicks "Contract" on a card; the
system opens that offer's contract document in a new browser tab.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the visitor opens
the Partners & Offers page
When the page renders
Then the system shall
display the hero (eyebrow, title, description, illustration), the offers
section (eyebrow, heading, description) and the category dropdown, reset action
and "Find" button, bilingual EN/AR with correct LTR/RTL.
Given partner offers are
published and within their validity window
When the page renders
Then only those offers
shall appear, each card showing the partner logo, category label, partner name,
location, offer description panel, the validity dates with the
"Valid" label, the membership tier badge, and the "Offer
details" and "Contract" actions.
Given the visitor has
applied no filter
When the page first
renders
Then the dropdown shall
default to "All Categories" and all published, in-validity offers
shall display.
Given the visitor selects
a category
When the visitor clicks
"Find"
Then only offers assigned
to that category, and within their validity window, shall display.
Given a category filter is
applied
When the visitor clicks
the reset action
Then the dropdown shall
return to "All Categories" and the full in-validity list shall be
restored.
Given more offers exist
beyond the initial page size
When the visitor clicks
"Load More"
Then the system shall
load and append the next set of offers, and hide or disable the action once no
further offers remain.
Given the visitor clicks
"Offer details" on a card
When the action is
triggered
Then the system shall
open the Offer Details modal for that offer.
Given an offer has a
contract document configured
When the visitor clicks
"Contract"
Then the system shall
open that document in a new browser tab.
Given an offer has no
contract document configured
When the card renders
Then the
"Contract" action shall not display.
Given categories are
maintained in the CMS
When a category is
activated
Then it shall appear
automatically as an option in the frontend dropdown, with no redevelopment
required.
Given the page is opened
on desktop, tablet or mobile
When it renders
Then the layout shall be
responsive.
Edge Cases
- If no offers are published, or none fall within their
validity window: "No offers are currently available." — لا توجد عروض
متاحة حالياً.
- If no offers exist for the selected category: "No
offers found in this category." — لا توجد عروض في هذه الفئة.
- If the selected-language translation is missing, fall
back to the active language.
Negative Scenarios
- Draft/unpublished offers shall not appear in the
listing.
- Expired offers, and offers whose validity has not yet
started, shall be suppressed automatically by the system validity check.
- Inactive categories shall not appear in the dropdown.
- A draft/unpublished page shall not be visible to
visitors.
Post-condition
The visitor has browsed or
filtered the partner offers and has either opened an offer's details or its
contract document.
2. Frontend — Offer Details Modal (US-002)
User Story
As a public website visitor,
I want to open an offer and read
its full terms before I try to use it,
So that I know exactly what the
benefit covers and what conditions apply.
Preconditions
- The offer is published and within its validity window.
- The offer's terms are configured.
What the Visitor Sees
- A modal overlaying the listing, with the page behind it
dimmed.
- Header: the partner logo, the category label, the
partner name, and the partner location with a marker icon; plus a close (X)
action.
- A "offer description" panel containing the
offer text.
- A validity line: a calendar icon, the label
"Valid", and the offer's start and end dates, with the membership
tier badge alongside.
- An "Offer terms" section containing the full
conditions of the offer.
- Footer actions: "Close" and "Open
contract".
Frontend Workflow
- Visitor clicks "Offer details" on an offer
card.
- System opens the Offer Details modal for that offer and
dims the listing behind it.
- System displays the partner logo, category, partner
name and location; the offer text in the " offer description" panel;
the validity dates and membership tier; and the full offer terms.
- Visitor reads the offer terms.
- Visitor clicks "Open contract"; the system opens
that offer's contract document in a new browser tab.
- Visitor clicks "Close" or the close (X)
action; the modal is dismissed and the visitor returns to the listing at the
same scroll position.
Acceptance Criteria
Given the visitor clicks
"Offer details" on a card
When the modal opens
Then the system shall
display the partner logo, category label, partner name and location, the "offer
description " panel, the validity dates, the membership tier badge and the
full offer terms, bilingual EN/AR with correct LTR/RTL.
Given the modal is open
When it renders
Then all content shall
belong to the selected offer and to no other.
Given the offer has a
contract document configured
When the visitor clicks
"Open contract"
Then the system shall
open that document in a new browser tab, leaving the modal open behind it.
Given the offer has no
contract document configured
When the modal renders
Then the "Open
contract" action shall not display.
Given the modal is open
When the visitor clicks
"Close", the close (X) action, the overlay, or presses Esc
Then the modal shall be
dismissed and the visitor shall return to the listing at the same scroll
position.
Given the modal is open
for one offer
When the visitor opens the
details of a different offer
Then the modal shall
switch to the newly selected offer rather than opening a second modal.
Given an offer has no
terms configured
When the modal renders
Then the "Offer
terms" section shall be hidden rather than rendering an empty heading.
Given the modal is opened
on desktop, tablet or mobile
When it renders
Then it shall be
responsive.
Edge Cases
- If the offer's validity lapses while the modal is open,
the visitor may continue reading; the offer will no longer appear on the
listing after a refresh.
- If the selected-language translation is missing, fall
back to the active language.
Negative Scenarios
- The modal shall not open for a draft, unpublished,
expired or not-yet-started offer.
- The modal shall never display content belonging to an
offer other than the one selected.
Post-condition
The visitor has read the offer's
full terms and has either opened the contract document or returned to the
listing.
3. Backend — Admin CMS Management: Offers
& Categories (US-003)
User Story
As a Site Content Editor or Site
Content Author,
I want to create and manage
partner offer records and maintain the partner category list,
So that Qatar Chamber can keep
an accurate, current listing of partner benefits on the website.
Preconditions
- The admin holds the required role in the Liferay CMS
(RBAC).
- The Partners & Offers page exists in the CMS for
both language versions.
Administrator Workflow
- Admin logs into the Liferay CMS and opens the Partners
& Offers management area.
- Enters or updates the hero and offers section content
(EN/AR).
- Selects "Create Partner Offer", or opens an
existing offer record.
- Enters the partner details — partner name, partner
logo, partner category and partner location (EN/AR).
- Enters the offer description and the full offer terms
(EN/AR).
- Sets the offer validity start and end dates.
- Assigns the membership tier (General / Elite / Quest /
Other).
- Uploads or links the offer contract document where one
applies.
- Saves as draft, previews, then publishes where
permitted; unpublishes or deletes an offer when required.
- Maintains the partner category and
membership tier lists — add, edit, reorder or deactivate entries without
redevelopment.
- System records all actions in the
audit log and shows the Liferay generic success toast (EN/AR).
Acceptance Criteria
Given the admin manages an
offer record
When the admin saves and
publishes
Then the system shall
allow create, edit, preview, publish, unpublish and delete for the record where
permitted.
Given the admin sets the
validity start and end dates
When the record is saved
Then the system shall
validate that the end date is after the start date and reject the save
otherwise.
Given the admin publishes
an offer
When the offer is live
Then it shall appear on
the frontend only while today's date falls within its validity window.
Given the admin assigns a
category to an offer
When the offer is published
Then the offer shall
appear under that category when the filter is applied.
Given the admin activates
a new partner category
When the change is saved
Then it shall appear
automatically as an option in the frontend dropdown, with no redevelopment
required.
Given a category has
published offers assigned to it
When the admin attempts to
deactivate that category
Then the system shall
warn the admin and require those offers to be reassigned first.
Given the admin uploads
the offer contract document
When the upload is
submitted
Then the system shall
validate the file is a PDF and reject any other format.
Given the admin enters the
offer terms
When the offer is
published
Then the terms shall
display in the "Offer terms" section of the Offer Details modal.
Given any change is made
When the admin acts
Then the system shall
display the Liferay generic toast messages and record the change in the audit
log.
Negative Scenarios
- Publishing without the mandatory fields — partner name
EN/AR, logo, category, offer description EN/AR, offer terms EN/AR, validity
start and end dates, and membership tier — shall trigger a validation error.
- Setting the validity end date before the start date
shall be blocked: "The end date must be after the start date." — يجب
أن يكون تاريخ الانتهاء بعد تاريخ البدء.
- Publishing without required bilingual content shall be
blocked: "Arabic content is required." — المحتوى بالعربية مطلوب.
- Uploading a non-PDF contract document shall be blocked:
"Unsupported file type. Only PDF is accepted." — نوع الملف غير مدعوم.
يُقبل ملف PDF فقط.
- Uploading an unsupported logo format or an oversized
image shall be blocked: "Unsupported file type or size." — نوع الملف
أو حجمه غير مدعوم.
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied. You
do not have permission to perform this action." — تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك
صلاحية لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post-condition
The offer record is published
and visible to public visitors while within its validity window. Expired and
not-yet-started offers are hidden automatically, and the partner category list
is maintained dynamically.

5. Permissions
Role
Capabilities
Site Content Editor
Create, edit, preview,
publish, unpublish and delete partner offer records; maintain the partner
category and membership tier lists; manage the page and section content.
Site Content Author
View and update assigned
partner offer records where permitted.
Public Visitor
View published, in-validity
partner offers; filter by category; open the offer details modal; open the
contract document.
6. Business Rules
- Only published partner offers that fall within their
validity window are visible to public visitors.
- An offer is within its validity window when today's
date falls on or between its validity start and end dates. Offers whose end
date has passed, and offers whose start date has not yet been reached, are both
hidden automatically.
- Partner offers of every category are managed using a
single common record structure.
- Partner categories are maintained dynamically in the
CMS — adding, renaming, reordering or deactivating a category requires no
redevelopment, and any active category appears automatically as a dropdown
option.
- A category with published offers assigned to it cannot
be deactivated until those offers are reassigned.
- The category filter is applied by the "Find"
button; the reset action returns the dropdown to "All Categories" and
restores the full list.
- The offer description appears on the card and in the
modal; the full offer terms appear in the modal only.
- The "Contract" action on the card and the
"Open contract" action in the modal both open the same document in a
new browser tab, and both are hidden when no contract is configured.
- The contract document must be a PDF file, or a valid
URL to one.
- Membership tier badges are drawn from a CMS-maintained
list with bilingual display labels.
- Offers load in sets through "Load More";
pagination is not used.
- Content is bilingual (EN/AR) with correct RTL support.
- Standard Draft → Preview → Publish → Unpublish
lifecycle; all admin actions respect RBAC, are audit-logged, and show the
Liferay generic success toast.
